certified_invariants: Health and Defensive Health Bridge recovery APIs require an explicit canonical recovery_id.
The first recovery request durably binds recovery_id to entity identity, evidence and confirming actor.
A retry with the same recovery_id and the same request binding is a no-op even when retried later.
The same recovery_id reused with different evidence or actor fails closed as a conflict.
A duplicate Health recovery cannot relax QUARANTINED to DEGRADED and then HEALTHY; a second relaxation requires a distinct explicit recovery_id.
A recovery acknowledgement recorded while Health is already HEALTHY cannot later be replayed after a future degradation to create an implicit recovery.
A duplicate Defensive Bridge recovery cannot relax NO_NEW_RISK to REDUCED and then NORMAL; a second relaxation requires a distinct explicit recovery_id.
A duplicate Defensive Bridge retry does not increment bridge_version, does not increment safety_state.version and does not create a second recovery ledger event.
A retry of an already accepted bridge recovery remains a no-op if it arrives after the underlying evidence becomes stale; a new recovery_id on stale evidence is rejected.
All recovery state changes remain transactional under SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE semantics.
explicit_non_claims: This is not R4 track certification.
Recovery acknowledgement does not grant broker, PAPER or LIVE authority.
